column3: Close to the Hebrew; “on my palate” is rendered “in my mouth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “like your mouth to God” is rendered “as your spokesman before God.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְאַכְפִּי (“my pressure”) is rendered “my hand.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he does not answer all his words” is rendered “He does not give an accounting of any of His words.”
Close to the Hebrew; “once … twice” is rendered “in one way, or in another.”
Close to the Hebrew; בַּשָּׁלַח (“by the weapon”) is rendered “by the sword.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who bring death” is rendered “the executioners.”
Close to the Hebrew; מַלְאָךְ (“messenger, angel”) is rendered “a messenger,” and “his uprightness” is capitalized as “His uprightness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his righteousness” is capitalized as God’s, “His righteousness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it was not equal to me” is rendered “it did not profit me.”
